title: 1,700+ Remote AI Training Jobs, Paying Up to $350/hr
excerpt: Find remote AI trainer jobs from Mercor, micro1, DataAnnotation and 20+ companies. Coding, law, medicine and languages. Median $37/hr, updated every 5 minutes.
content_html:
Remote AI trainer jobs

Earn extra income. 1701 remote jobs from 24 platforms for coders, lawyers, doctors, linguists, and more. Paid $5–130 an hour. Updated every 5 minutes.

Open jobs

1701 jobs

Frequently asked questions

What is an AI trainer job?

AI trainers help companies improve AI models. You review and rate model answers, write example answers, find mistakes, or record voice and video data. Experts in law, medicine, coding, languages, and other fields teach models how a professional thinks. Most of this work is remote, flexible, and paid by the hour.

How much do AI trainers earn?

Right now the median rate is $37/hr across 1559 open hourly jobs on this site. The highest is $450/hr. Generalist tasks pay the least. Expert roles pay the most, in fields like law, medicine, finance, and coding. Each job page shows the hourly rate when the company lists it.

Are AI trainer jobs remote?

Yes. Every job on this site is remote, and most have flexible hours. Some jobs accept people from certain countries only, so check the 🌍 location on each job before you apply.

What skills or degrees do I need?

It depends on the job. Generalist jobs need clear writing and attention to detail. Expert jobs usually ask for a degree or work experience in the field, such as a law license or medical training. Language jobs need native or fluent skill in that language. Coding jobs need real programming experience.

How do I get hired as an AI trainer?

Open a job that fits your skills and apply on the company's site. At micro1 and Mercor, you add your resume, then do a short AI-led interview about your experience. If you pass, the company matches you to projects. Apply to several jobs that fit you to raise your chances.

Which companies hire AI trainers?

Many AI data companies hire trainers, for example micro1, Mercor, Outlier, Handshake AI, and Alignerr. Today we list micro1, Mercor, Anyone AI, Terac, Vetto, Meridial, DataAnnotation, Prolific, xAI, Appen, RWS TrainAI, Innodata, Mindrift, Kaya, CloudFactory, Perle, OneForma, HumanSignal, Welo Data, Handshake AI, Rise Data Labs, DataForce, LXT, and DATAmundi jobs, and we are adding more companies soon.

Is AI training work legit?

Yes, with established companies. They pay for real work, and they never ask you to pay to apply. Be careful with any offer that asks for money, gift cards, or bank logins. We only list jobs from the companies' own job boards.

How often are jobs updated?

We check every company for new and closed jobs every 5 minutes. The last check was 1min ago. When a job closes, we mark it as closed.

How does AI Trainer Jobs make money?

Some Apply buttons use our referral link. If a company hires you through it, the company may pay us a referral fee. You pay nothing, and your pay does not change. We list jobs with and without referral programs.
